headline: Forest Leave Portman Road With a Point, but Chances Go Begging

sentences.text: Nott'm Forest will leave Portman Road frustrated by a 1–1 draw after creating enough to take more from Ipswich Town.
Neco Williams put Forest ahead in the 13th minute, assisted by Daniel Muñoz, but Julio Enciso levelled for Ipswich in the 41st.
The sides went in level at half-time, and neither could find a second-half winner.
Forest had 17 shots to Ipswich’s 7 and an xG of 2.29 against 0.46, a clear measure of the attacking opportunity that went unrewarded.
They also registered 5 shots on target and 5 corners, while Ipswich had 3 shots on target and no corners.
The point lifts Nott'm Forest from 19th to 16th, leaving them on 6 points after 8 matches; Ipswich move to 9th on 10 points.
